tools.name: loopreturns_list_returns
tools.description: List returns created or updated in a time range, with state, items and totals. Defaults to the last 24 hours and to open, closed and expired returns. Loop API: GET /warehouse/return/list.

tools.name: loopreturns_get_return
tools.description: Get one return with its items, reasons, outcomes and money fields. Pass return_id, order_id or order_name (at least one). Loop API: GET /warehouse/return/details.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_return_notes
tools.description: List the internal notes on one return. Loop API: GET /warehouse/return/{id}/notes.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_shipping_notices
tools.description: List return packages with their tracking status in a date range (advanced shipping notice data). Loop API: GET /warehouse/reporting/asn.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_orders
tools.description: List orders known to Loop, paginated. Loop API: GET /orders.

tools.name: loopreturns_get_order
tools.description: Get the details of one order by its Loop id. Loop API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: loopreturns_check_order_return_eligibility
tools.description: Report per-line-item return eligibility for an order by its order name, without starting a return. Loop API: POST /orders/return-eligibility.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_blocklist
tools.description: List the blocklist entries that stop returns for a customer or value. Loop API: GET /blocklists.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_happy_returns_shipments
tools.description: List Happy Returns drop-off shipments created in a time range, paginated (200 per page). Loop API: GET /happy-returns/shipments.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_destinations
tools.description: List the return destinations (warehouses or addresses) set up in Loop. Loop API: GET /destinations.

tools.name: loopreturns_add_return_note
tools.description: WRITE: post a new internal note (max 255 characters) on a return. Staff in Loop see it. Loop API: POST /warehouse/return/{id}/note.

tools.name: loopreturns_flag_return
tools.description: WRITE: flag a return for human review. Loop then stops automated processing until a merchant reviews it in Loop Admin. Loop API: POST /warehouse/return/{id}/flag.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: loopreturns_check_order_return_eligibility · Public sink: loopreturns_check_order_return_eligibility, loopreturns_add_return_note, loopreturns_flag_return · Destructive: loopreturns_list_happy_returns_shipments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: loopreturns_check_order_return_eligibility · Public sink: loopreturns_check_order_return_eligibility, loopreturns_add_return_note, loopreturns_flag_return · Destructive: loopreturns_list_happy_returns_shipments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
